Game Overview

At its heart, Space Bricks is a arcade game about maneuver your paddle in Space Bricks, a 3D breakout adventure. Smash vibrant bricks with your ball, gather power-ups, and tackle unique level challenges. With dazzling visuals and an addictive rhythm, hone your reflexes solo or with friends in multiplayer as you aim for mastery.
